Adding a weapon type or a gun is an edit here, then build.sh all.
status: release = built and shipped, test = only with build.sh --with-test, disabled = data kept, never built.
A gun without a status takes its type status. Pistols and revolvers are release as Shingen partners; their types are test.
An empty vars list: the gun shares another gun model variable (see its note).

set_names._note: The per-hand reload arm sets. Up to 3.2.0 they were named _lowered (not the lowered stance); verify compares a renamed set with the reference's old name.

raised_families._about: Raised pose per gun: game pose + s * dir (idle clips) or s * aim_dir (aim), in metres, right hand (x = right, y = up, z = back); roll in degrees about the barrel and clavicle scaled by min(1, s / s_ref). The muzzle direction never changes. target: screen cover (percent, one gun) the autotune stops at.

checks._about: Thresholds of build.sh check. baseline = the worst value measured on the shipped clips (3.2.0), kept as the limit; the others are the documented rules.

endpose._note: Last frame against idlepose_shoulder, per hand, world space (shipped worst 0.003 cm, 0.007 deg). Frames before the seated frame equal the clip before the fix (cm or deg). Hands and guns keep their path over the fix (baseline 0.04 cm, 0.08 deg).

sets._note: Shipped clips are SIMD buffers (a compressed buffer breaks the first-person camera) and keep the key count of the glb they were imported from. resampled_baseline: [glb keys, frames in the set] of the shipped clips that do not (per-hand reload 139, lowered 121, 43, 16, raised pose sets 26 (vault, idlepose_frenzy) and 16, a raised gun's melee 46: the import stores one frame less and resamples); 96 and 112 keys come back exact.

topmag._note: eye_long_cm: was 20.0 set by hand (BRIEF_LONG.md 1, BRIEF_LONG2.md 2: eye clearance >= 20 cm); now the worst of the population of shipped long-partner clips (522 items, 52 guns and pairs, pstd 2026-11-24: Masamune 19.3, next Carnage 20.2), no margin, as wrist_view_bind_max_deg. A measured floor of what the owner has played, not a physical distance. rreload.eye_min_cm 20 (the generators' solver constant) is also hand-set: the population minimum of rgate eye_cm over shipped and approved clips is 16.0 (Dian, idle 16.8) and the approved Warden raised variants sit at 20.0, so lowering it would change solved offsets; left at 20, listed as open. Sources per limit: THRESHOLDS in authoring/topmag/checks.py. Baselines (shipped worst, the documented rule is stricter and the shipped clips miss it): contact_miss_smg_cm 2.5 (rule 2.0; Burya on right uppercut top_std 2.48), hidden_speed_cm 0.85 (rule: nearly still; pair_SS_scissor 0.81, pair_SS_clap 0.5), eye_smg_cm 0.5 (tables: 5; doubletap category clips with Warden, Borg, Shingen, Dian, generic SMG). Also baselines: hand_on_gun_cm, contact_depth_pair_cm, hands_gap_cm, wrist_deg.

magtrack._note: The flight gates of authoring/magtrack/mag_flight.py. exit was 25 deg set by hand (mag_flight GATES exit_deg); it is now the worst of the shipped population (18 picks: 46.2, long_left_lupper; next 45.6 long_right_hang, the Shingen Masamune clip), no margin, and the exit entries of baseline.json are gone. The shipped tracks miss exit (4 picks, up to 46.2 deg), contact (2 picks) and touch_gap (8 picks); those items are accepted at their recorded values in authoring/magtrack/baseline.json and marked baseline in the output.

roundtrip._note: Built set exported back by WolvenKit against the glb it was imported from. Baselines of one set of each kind: hands and guns 0.80 cm, 0.80 deg (the per-hand reload set, resampled by the import), any arm joint 7.9 cm (a finger joint in a category set).

discard._note: Discard layer (authoring/reload/discard.py, one rule for every gun). lead_frames: the offset is complete this many frames before the release (the window the pvis measure and plow used: release - 7). vertex_step: every 20th vertex of the assembled gun mesh is tested. eps: margin the magazine well point and the hand joints keep inside the frame (the R9 rounding, 0.001 of the half frame). The discard event is the magazine leaving the well (release to free_from of the track; tube and break: the spent hulls leaving). R9 target: in every frame of the event the share of gun vertices inside the game camera frame is at least the share in the shipped raised idle (frame 0 of the shipped clip, per body, rounded down to 0.001), the well point and every hand joint are inside with eps, no gun point is nearer than checks.rreload.eye_min_cm to the eye and the hand stays within reach_max of the arm length. It replaces the worst-vertex margin of the idle (copperhead -9.86, dian -17.02: a stock vertex a few cm from the eye projects far outside the frame, so the margin said nothing).

lowered_variant._note: Lowered-stance reload variants (authoring/reload/lowprod.py, rules in its header). lead: frames the wind-up hold is shortened when the stop is solved from the arrival (plift2, ST38). return_frames: the overlay back to the lowered pose runs over the last 16 frames of the clip (b = last frame - 16; plift3 b 60 of 77, never searched). s_halvings: bisection steps of the post-seat gesture scale s (reach and shoulder limits of checks.rreload). R9 (whole gun and hand in the game camera frame with the shipped idle's own worst vertex margin, from the arrival to the frame the magazine has left the frame) is the `lowvar` area of build.sh check.

rreload._note: Rifle reload clips (authoring/reload/rgate.py). end: first and last frame against the gun's raised idle, own arm. wrist_view_bind_max_deg: wrist swing (the hand against the forearm, twist about the forearm left out) from the bind pose, largest over the frames in which the hand or forearm is on screen; 72.7 is the largest value of the 396 shipped and parked clips (break, Igla BR20A), no margin (plift4: gg-work/migration/plift4/wrist_all.json, wristall.py). It replaces 70 deg from the clip's idle: the idle is itself 32.7 deg from the bind pose, so a bend toward the straight wrist scored as a large change, and for a lowered variant the idle is another pose (shipped ST40B scored 71.7 against the lowered idle). Shipped clips scored 70.0 or less against the raised idle and 72.7 or less from the bind pose. hidden: between hide_start and hide_end the gun, its hand and forearm and every magazine are off screen in first person; the window holds the seat and must not hold the handle hit. mag_hang: frames a detached magazine is in the air and not in free fall. release_dv: jump of the magazine's world velocity where the guided slide ends and the free fall starts, gravity taken off. off_axis: sideways offset from the well axis in the last 10 cm of the insertion and the first 10 cm of the exit. handle_sets false: the H1 handle part sets (rreload.has_handle, hpartset.py) are not built, except for a gun with reload.handle_set (the bodies to build; Ajax pma, in-game trial), whose sets go through the weapon set import path (wsetimport.py) (in game, the weapon-side Barrel part sets broke Ajax, Sidewinder, Tactician and Igla). Key counts are padded to rarmset.good_keys (import test in production/import_length).

s1._note: S1 (pfix3): the rise of a variant's arm-chain roughness over its shipped control, after hide_end: the worst rise of the 12 approved Warden variants (clavicle jerk +0.1, chain jerk +0.6, clavicle sign changes 0) x 1.1. The 34 rejected follow-rise clips (pma): 30 exceed. See authoring/checks/smooth.py; data pfix3/arm_cal.json.

h1._note: H1 (pfix3, owner 2026-11-25): the handle part changes state only on frames out of view and ends where the vanilla reload leaves it. Joints: handle-like names of the gun's base1 or rcv1 set that move over min_peak_cm (10 deg = 1 cm). change_cm: per-frame change that counts as moving (the stays_moved threshold of timing.py is 0.5 cm for the whole stroke). end_tol_cm = the stays_moved threshold. Playback clock unverified in game (see authoring/checks/hfix.py).

h2._note: H2 (pshot, owner 2026-11-15 in-game flapping barrels): breakphys.hinge_stats on the clip's _hinge_deg: up-crossings of 20 deg after being under 10 deg (opens), down-crossings of 10 deg after being open (closes), largest dip below the running maximum before the final close starts. The 36 shipped break drafts have 2 to 3 opens and dips of 28 to 51 deg; breakphys.drive_hinge (applied in breakprod.build) gives 1, 1, 0. The 3 deg allows the settle on the open stop.

flick._note: F1, F2 (pshot, owner 2026-11-25, Carnage toss-cock): free flight is pure ballistic (the centre of mass second difference equals gravity within 0.05 cm/f2, spin change under 0.05 deg/f), a catch puts the hand on the part within 0.5 cm and the hand speed equals the part speed within 1.5 cm/f (the hand and the part move together at the catch, no teleport). max_frames 31 = the Carnage CycleTime 1.06 s at 30 fps. Built clips: flick2.py, 30 frames.

l1._note: L1 (pfix3, owner 2026-11-25): the last move to the lowered idle. Limit = the worst slow drift (0.15 to 0.5 cm/f after the rise) of the owner-approved clips: Warden ST32B/ST38B/ST40B 6 (literally perfect) and Zhuo SF35B 7 (SF40B 4). Zhuo SF13B (9) is rejected by the owner (2026-11-25: the settle to the idle is too long, target the idle position directly) and fails. Below 0.15 cm/f is the clip's own ease-out. Tail frames are reported, not gated (a clip may hold still after its rise).

tm1._note: TM1 (paudit/TIMING.md): hidden_min_frames = checks.rreload.hidden_min_frames; max_speed = GorillaAkimboReload.MaxSpeed (GorillaAkimbo.reds); fire_buffer_s = FireBuffer (the rise settles this long after the state ends). Stats: reload.stats of each gun, from the TweakDB dump (Items.Base_<gun>_Handling_Stats).

arm_spring._note: Arm spring of the r3lib reload generators (bull3, top3, top4, top5). source label: the take label (r3lib.SPRING, as shipped). source mass: from the gun's measured mass and inertia (gunmass.arm_spring): w_p^2 = k_pos / (m_gun + m_arm), w_r^2 = k_rot / (I_arm + I_gun), damping ratio zeta. k_pos and k_rot are the geometric mean over the two shipped r3lib guns (Pulsar A, Warden B) of w^2 times the mass (reload/springfit.py). Stays on label until the owner approves.

_notes.lift: Natural lift limit (owner 2026-11-24: showing the discard is not required for every reload and never for very large guns: lifting them into view does not look natural). A discard-visible variant is made only where the offset that brings the discard into view is within the approved Warden variants' worst x 1.1: stop offset 42.3 cm (ST38B, norm of stop_m) and pitch 21.62 deg, so 46.5 cm and 23.8 deg (checks.lowered_variant.discard.max_offset_cm, max_pitch_deg). Size (owner calibration: Masamune is too big to raise, Warden is fine; the lift alone would allow Masamune, 21.7 cm): the gun's screen cover in the raised game pose (the pose rule measure) at most the Warden's 11.3 % x 1.1 = 12.4 % (Masamune 15.0, Borg 13.5 and Hercules 13.0 fall above, Shingen 10.6 and Dian 10.2 below). Above it no variant is made and the shipped clip stays in that stance; R9 gates only variants that are made. Per gun and stance: pstd/VARIANTS.md. Covers halted LMG, precision and sniper work too (untouched).
_notes.r9: R9 discard visible (calibrated 2026-11-24 on the owner-approved clips): release .. free_from, every joint of the reloading hand in the game camera frame (margin >= 0; approved worst 0.024) and the magazine well point in the frame on at least 0.8 of those frames (approved 24 Warden variants: 0.8 to 1.0; SV13 and SV14 finals 1.0). Rejects round 5 ST55B/58B/59B/63B (well in the frame 0 of 3, hand margin -0.4 to -1.3) and the shipped ST38B (hand -8.1), ST40B (hand -0.135) and ST32B (well 0.33 to 0.5). Replaces the phook coverage target (share of gun vertices in the frame >= the idle's 0.937), which fails every approved clip (0.577 to 0.902). Evidence: gg-work/migration/pstd/cal/r9cal.py, r9cal.json.
_notes.speed: R12 pvan2 speed caps (gg-work/migration/pvan2/limits.json, evalrules.py): top = worst of the 24 approved Warden variants x 1.1; every other family = worst over the shipped clips and the vanilla reloads x 1.1.
_notes.still_run_max: R13 no dead pause: longest run of near-still gun frames (grip step under 0.5 cm/f and turn under 1 deg/f) between the release and hide_start; shipped discard phases: worst 5 frames (pvan2).
_notes.warden_only: R14 and R11 limits were measured on the Warden mesh and the 24 approved Warden variants (pvan2 limits.json R1_*, R5_*): spin peak and spin at entry on the frames the gun is back in the frame, hidden frames visible 0, inward reach (min x) and lateral reach (max x) of the mirrored gun and arm points. Not applied to any other gun (no approved reference for another mesh).

_notes.finger_torque_nm: R7 net finger torque on the in-hand turn frames (the gun turning relative to the hand), N m: I alpha minus the gravity moment of the centre of mass about the in-hand spin pivot, gun mass and inertia from the mesh (reload/gunmass.py: voxel solid, uniform density 1000 kg/m3, so the number scales with density). No margin. Source: Warden ST32B, the only approved clip that turns the gun in the hand and the one the owner called borderline on 2026-11-23: its peak over the four clips (right 4.173, left 4.032), rounded up to 3 decimals. It is the edge of what the owner accepted, not a human limit. I alpha alone is 3.51 for ST32B (ptorque); the gravity moment adds up to 0.66 at the peak frame, hence 4.174 and not 3.51. Arm-driven turns (the gun fixed in the hand, 15 to 100 N m in approved clips) are not judged. Gap: all negatives are Warden, so the limit reaches other guns only through the inertia model; a light gun has few spins that can exceed it. Evidence: gg-work/migration/ptorque2/REPORT.md.
_notes.phys_floor: R3 and R4a tolerance, one set: the noise floor of the measures, which is float rounding of the glb and track, measured by the pphys survey (gg-work/migration/pphys/REPORT.md, floors.json, gate.py) on 654 clips (shipped and parked, negatives, drafts). pos_cm_f 0.000328: largest residual of a free-flight fit (206 segments, 1486 frames); a seated part steps exactly 0 (26059 frames in 442 clips). acc_cm_f2 0.00065: largest per-frame acceleration residual against g (vertical 0.00038, horizontal 0.00065) over the non-contact flight frames of shipped clips whose old R2 magazine count was 0. rot_deg_f 0.0003: largest per-frame change of spin over the same frames (segment fits 0.00014). The per-frame pool is drawn from shipped clips at rounding scale (noted); with it 0 of 300 shipped magazine flights fail (the segment floors left 12 SF40 clips at 1.1 to 1.5 floors). Gated: R3 (magazine and shell free flight at g) and R4a (a fresh magazine with no contact is still or at g). Frames in contact or carried are exempt; loading and ejection frames near the hands are not judged (counted in the note). Reported, not gated (R1 block): release linear and angular impulse and the carrier-energy bound: the model has no catch spring, friction or wall contact, and the bound fails 172 of 300 shipped clips, approved ones included.
_notes.r2_outside_accel_max: R2 frames in which a part travels outside every gun acceleration frame (the window is widened by 1 frame each side; the magazine sliding out after the release lies inside it). Gated: pump 0 (survey r2: 0 on every shipped clip). The magazine (ST32B has 4: the fresh magazine rises while the gun is still, now judged by R4a), barrels (the hinge settles onto its stop under gravity) and shells are reported in the R2 block, not gated; the magazine and shells are judged by R3 and R4a. Frame sheets of the extremes: regen/REPORT-2b.md.
_notes.r2b_pump_closing_x_mean_min: R2b pump closing x_mean (draft check, added after the 2026-11-14 owner complaint that the pump slid home after the rise had ended). x_mean = mean gun grip speed over the moving frames of a pump closing run, divided by the clip's peak grip speed; the run is cut from the pump's own track (_pump_cm, step over 0.3 cm, gaps of one frame merged), never from generator marks. Gated: pump closing runs only, at least 0.16. Exempt, each by name: falling magazine (free fall, gravity); well slide (a released magazine sliding down the well, gravity); hand-entered magazine (a fresh magazine moved into the well by the hand or belt rig while the gun is nearly still); ballistic shells (a flying hull); driven shells (live shell loaded by hand, hull pushed by the ejector); barrels (hinge bounce and settle on the stop, spring and gravity; approved runs reach 0.001); pump opening (the yank; approved 0.138 to 0.186, pre-fix 0.167 to 0.225, overlapping). Source: prefix-tube SURVEY-XMEAN over 500 clips and 1986 runs. Facts, and the rule is WEAK: one family (tube), six pick and gun pairs on each side (TU21 to TU23 on Carnage and Tactician, 4 near-identical runs per pair), approved pump closing minimum 0.172 (24 runs), the 24 rebuilt pre-fix clips maximum 0.154; the ratio is 1.12. 0.16 sits between them; 0.14 would miss 2 of the 24 pre-fix runs. It holds on this data and is not robust: re-survey before trusting it on another family or a new pump pick. Reported, not gated: median over peak (approved 0.178 to 0.660, pre-fix 0.037 to 0.117) and the share of run frames under 1 cm/f (approved 0 to 0.25, pre-fix 0.33 to 1.0), in the R2b block of each _draft.json.
_notes.r4_budget: R4 clip length and key count per family and take. Source: largest value in the survey and the gate layouts (front: the longest gun clip, 113; the other rifle and tube lengths follow the gun clip).
_notes.r5_min: R5 lower bounds per family: grip pace and the hardest stop loss (cm/f). Grip pace = peak grip speed of the clip's longest big move (8 cm or more) divided by that move's length (1/frame; for a minimum-jerk move it is 1.875 over the move's frames), so it does not depend on how far the move goes: a clip that starts and ends in the lowered idle has a shorter rise from the belt than one that starts in the raised idle, at the same pace (ST38B rise: shipped 0.155, lowered variant 0.158). It replaces the absolute grip peak speed (cm/f), which scored the shorter move as slower (plift4/REPORT.md). Source: survey minimum x 0.9 over the 396 shipped and parked clips of the manifest (gg-work/migration/plift4/r5_shipped_min.json, r5rule.py), rounded down to 0.001; stop loss: survey minimum x 0.9, rounded down to 0.1. grip 0.104 and 4.2, bullpup 0.102 and 2.7, top 0.125 and 4.5, smg_front 0.097 and 2.6, front 0.135 and 4.7, masamune 0.215 and 8.4, hercules 0.197 and 6.4, tube 0.130 and 3.9, break 0.071 and 1.5 (the stop loss values are the ones in use; the earlier text of this note listed other numbers). No upper bounds.
_notes.r10_swing_max_deg_f: WRIST CHANGED 2026-11-24 (round 3): 41.51 to 94.1 = the owner-approved set worst x 1.1 (Warden ST38B lowered and raised variants, 85.54 deg/f at the release frame, in view and approved by eye); the shipped-based 41.51 failed those clips. The other joints keep worst shipped x 1.1. Rejected clips still fail other gates (R12 whole-clip speeds for round 5, R8 and R7 for round 4; see STANDARD.md); R10 alone no longer rejects ST55B (90.36) and ST63B (89.04), only the owner-eye rules R15 and R16 cover robotic. Original note: R10 peak swing speed of each arm joint, deg/f (checks/armspeed.py: direction of the child bone in the parent frame, twist dropped, 30 fps). Source: worst of the 396 shipped and parked reload clips x 1.1, rounded up to 0.01 (worst: clavicle 9.35 igla_right_BR17A_empty_reload, shoulder 30.80 tactician_right_TU22A_empty_reload, elbow 47.77 ajax_right_F02A_empty_reload, wrist 37.73 palica_right_BR17A_reload; the vanilla Lexington reloads peak lower: 2.6, 16.4, 35.7, 30.5). 0 shipped clips fail. Round 5 ST55B wrist 90.4 (ST63B 89.0, ST59B 64.5, ST58B 48.4; the other 6 draft at most 23.7). The other arm features tried (velocity-profile shape, jerk, coupling, joints at once, plateaus) do not separate ST55B from shipped clips.
_notes.r8_min: R8 sustained speed lower bounds per family and take (survey.sustained): gun path in cm (path_cm) and 90th percentile gun speed in cm/f (v90_cm_f) over the whole clip, and the same over the release phase (rel_path_cm, rel_v90_cm_f; the gun first leaving rest to release + 3, release from the clip's track). R5 bounds one frame; these bound how long the gun keeps moving. Source: the 396 shipped and parked approved reload clips of the manifest (pma and pwa, both hands, reload and empty_reload; gg-work/migration/pwarden2/r8_shipped.json, script r8survey.py), worst per family and take x 0.9, rounded down to 0.01, as R5. 0 of them fail. Top B: the worst release phase is the in-hand turn of ST32B (19.1 cm, v90 1.54); ST38B and ST40B have 40 to 66 cm and 4.5 to 6.7, so without ST32B the top bounds would be rel_path 36.0 and rel_v90 4.02 and path 134.5. The release rows of break and tube measure the cue to the break or open, not a magazine release. Top B release rows changed 2026-11-24 (pstd): rel_path 17.19 to 15.32 and rel_v90 1.38 to 1.10 = the owner-approved Warden ST32B lowered and raised variants (24 approved clips) worst x 0.9 (17.03 cm, 1.229 cm/f). The old floor came from the shipped ST32B (19.1 cm, 1.536), whose release is an in-hand turn; the approved variants stop the arm from a shorter distance. Not a silent loosening: the round 4 drafts the owner called too slow (ST44 to ST53) still fail 10/10 on the whole-clip v90 (4.18 to 5.24 vs approved 5.53 and floor 5.43), while their release v90 (min 1.189) overlaps the approved ST32B variants, so the release rows cannot separate them. No upper bounds. Evidence: gg-work/migration/pwarden2/REPORT.md.
_notes.baselines: Named exceptions: clip name pattern -> metric -> accepted value. None. Owner rule 2026-11-23: no exceptions; the ST32B baseline was removed and ST32B fails until the clip is fixed.

draft._note: Draft rules R1 to R6 plus R2b, R4a, R7 and R8 (authoring/checks/draftcheck.py, area draft of build.sh check). Every limit has its source in _notes. R6 uses checks.rreload end_max_cm and end_max_deg. Measures and their thresholds: authoring/checks/survey.py; the survey of 508 clips: gg-work/migration/survey/SURVEY.md.

_notes.v1d_over_cm: The pose rule (owner, 2026-11-23): the length gives the preferred lowered family: v1d when the assembled gun (parts and seated standard magazine, every vertex, z extent: authoring/lowered/guns.py length_cm) is longer than this, else v1. It applies only if a tune passes every lowered check (authoring/lowered/fit.py, the checks of area lowered on both bodies), else the other family. No category or hand length. The edge lies in the gap between the longest v1 gun (carnage, 85.8 cm) and the shortest v1d gun (igla, 92.8 cm). v2 is no longer used by a gun. Checked by build.sh check --only pose; autotune.py tunes the family the rule gives.

lowered._note: seam: loop seam and clip ends against the idle's first frame, cm or deg. eye_min_cm: closest gun point in the lowered idle. eye_closer_than_raised_max_cm: baseline 0.91 (two Zhuos; 0.7 with a Dian): where a gun is under eye_min_cm, safe_action may come this much nearer than the game's raised pose. gun_gap_min_cm: baseline, Satara + Carnage in the game's raised pose; a pair that is closer in the raised pose (two Sataras, 14.0) must not get closer than that. wrist_idle_max_deg: the autotune rule. wrist_max_deg: baseline, v2 equip_safe.

_notes.eye_aim_min_cm: Nearest gun point to the eye in the raised aim pose, or the game aim pose value where that is lower (as eye_min_cm for the idle). Source: the five shipped raised poses, aim eye min 17.2 cm (sidewinder left; copperhead 17.8, umbra 17.3, masamune 19.4, hercules 25.3), 0.5 cm margin. Game aim poses are 11.6 to 22.0 cm (dian 11.6; its raised aim measures 15.7). rautotune stops at this limit as well.

raised._note: camera: eye and horizontal fov (16:9) of the metric, fitted to game screenshots of 2026-11-11. limit_pct: the autotune reports a gun without a raised entry that covers more than this in the game pose (Ajax 8.0, Sidewinder 9.3, Masamune 15.0). reach: shoulder to wrist over arm length in the idle. wrist: bend from the bind pose (game pose 43) and change against the game pose. eye_min_cm, gap_min_cm: or the game pose value where that is lower. end_max: reload clips and top-magazine clips against the gun's raised idle, first and last frame. pose_clip_extra_cm: a pose clip may miss the raised idle by what the game clip misses the game idle, plus this. hand_clip_end_max_cm: equip end, unequip start, melee ends against the raised idle (baseline: the Lexington clips miss the game idle by up to 0.5 cm at the hand). topmag_window: frames of a top-magazine clip left untouched: the partner arm eases out of its raised pose before the first, and back into it between the second and topmag_back_by, while the guns are down out of view, so it rises straight into the raised pose (eased over the rise it came up at pistol height and sank: seen in game). end_max_cm 0.02: the reload clips made from the empty reload differ from the idle by the body pose of that clip, 0.011 cm.
